title: Grateful Dead Live at The Sportatorium on 1977-05-22
lineage: Cassette (Nakamichi BX-300) > Apogee MiniMe > Lynx One > Wavelab 8 > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture with 24‑bit depth that sounds solid, but the show itself receives little concrete commentary.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard (SBD) source offered in both 16‑ and 24‑bit versions; reviewers note the higher bit depth but admit the audible difference is minimal. Aside from a brief enthusiastic nod to the performance, there are no specific musical observations, making it hard to assess the show's quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviewers gave high marks praising the recording's bit depth and overall vibe, while one provided no musical feedback; limited detail yields a cautious rating leaning toward decent but not exceptional.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Available in both 16‑bit and 24‑bit FLAC; reviewers note the 24‑bit is technically higher quality though the audible difference may be negligible. No complaints about clarity or mix.
